Test Case Title: Verify a text file generated from entered text can be downloaded with correct content
Preconditions: Browser is launched; 'Download Files' page is open; browser download folder is empty
Test Steps: 1. Enter text in the text area 2. Click 'Generate and Download Text File' 3. Click 'Download Text File' 4. Wait for info.txt in the download folder 5. Read the file content
Expected Result: info.txt is downloaded and its content equals the entered text

Test Case Title: Verify a PDF file generated from entered text can be downloaded
Preconditions: Browser is launched; 'Download Files' page is open; browser download folder is empty
Test Steps: 1. Enter text in the text area 2. Click 'Generate and Download PDF File' 3. Click 'Download PDF File' 4. Wait for info.pdf in the download folder 5. Check the file size
Expected Result: info.pdf is downloaded and is not empty
